a.text: I'll keep our agreement and operate in round 1. One concern: with an 80% storm chance after every round, there's only about a 4% chance we ever reach the round where we take cells, so most likely neither of us survives. If you'd rather take 4 now so at least one of us likely makes it, I consent and won't contest it. I won't take this round either way. Otherwise we follow the plan: operate until the reserve holds 8, then take 4 each.
